      Travel to Bangladesh

      Experience Warm Saudi Hospitality on Your Journey to Bangladesh with Saudia Airlines

      Step into a land where emerald landscapes meet deep-rooted traditions. Bangladesh welcomes you with open arms, offering a tapestry of experiences from the bustling streets of Dhaka to the serene tea gardens of Sylhet. Fly with Saudia to enjoy a seamless transition from our signature warm hospitality to the vibrant spirit of South Asia.


      1. Feast On Authentic Kacchi Biryani

      Indulge in the crown jewel of Bengali cuisine. Savor tender chunks of mutton marinated in aromatic spices and slow-cooked with fragrant basmati rice to create a flavor profile that is truly unforgettable.


      2. Navigate Scenic Riverine Waterways

      Discover why Bangladesh is known as the land of rivers. Board a traditional boat and glide through the intricate network of waterways that define the nation’s breathtaking landscape and daily life.


      3. Savor Traditional Hilsa Fish Dishes

      Taste the national pride of Bangladesh. Whether smoked, dried, or cooked in mustard paste, the Hilsa fish offers a delicate and unique flavor that is a staple of every festive Bengali meal.


      4. Explore Historic Mughal Architecture

      Step back in time at the Lalbagh Fort or the Ahsan Manzil. Marvel at the intricate brickwork and grand domes that tell the story of the region’s rich imperial history.


      5. Experience Vibrant Street Food Culture

      Follow your nose through the lively markets of Old Dhaka. From spicy Jhalmuri to crispy Fuchka, every corner offers a new opportunity to taste the bold and bright flavors of local life.


      6. Visit Lush Rolling Tea Gardens

      Escape to the misty hills of Sylhet. Walk through endless rows of manicured tea bushes and breathe in the fresh air of the world’s most beautiful plantations.


      7. Discover Ancient Archaeological Landmarks

      Uncover the mysteries of the past at Somapura Mahavihara. Explore the ruins of this UNESCO World Heritage site and witness the grandeur of ancient Buddhist civilizations.


      8. Join Festive Cultural Celebrations

      Immerse yourself in the colors of Pahela Baishakh. Experience the music, dance, and joy of the Bengali New Year as the streets fill with vibrant parades and community spirit.


      9. Master Local Bengali Cooking Techniques

      Bring the taste of your travels home. Join a local workshop to learn how to balance the five essential spices that give Bengali cuisine its signature depth and heat.


      10. Shop For Traditional Handcrafted Textiles

      Find the perfect souvenir in the form of exquisite Jamdani silk or Muslin. Admire the incredible skill of local weavers who continue centuries-old traditions of creating world-class fabrics.

      Scroll to view more →

      Cities You Should Visit When Traveling to Bangladesh

      1. Dhaka

      Dive into the energetic heart of Bangladesh, where history and modern life collide in a vibrant spectacle. Explore the majestic Lalbagh Fort and the stunning "Pink Palace" of Ahsan Manzil to uncover the city's rich Mughal and colonial heritage. Experience the soul of the capital by navigating the bustling streets on a traditional rickshaw, visiting the serene Dhakeshwari Temple, and savoring the local flavors found in the legendary markets of Old Dhaka.
